name: Stacy Connor
source:
Stacy Connor is a maid of the Kuki family. She came to Kuki Group to make fun of [url=/c9791]Azumi[/url] for being a maid but was beaten by [url=/c5872]Hume[/url]. Stacy was trained in United States military force, and knows how to use all kind of guns, and fight in close combat. She is ranked number 15 between the maids and butlers of the Kuki Group.

Before she joined the Kuki Group, she was a member of the Green Berets and was a gun tech.
